text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having heard that a joint training session was being held,
I came out to observe today.

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, once you're done stretching,
let's write down today's goals in our notebooks!

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Consecutive Grand Prix victories", "Expanding overseas"—
Anything goes, aim big!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of the trainers in charge of the participating horse girls
seems to be taking the lead and running things, but—

text_block_list.name: Fickle Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, even if you tell us 'goals, goals' every single time...
I'm totally out of ideas...

text_block_list.name: Pessimistic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Besides, back-to-back Grand Prix wins or going overseas...
...You're aiming way too high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few negative murmurs can be heard. Well, it's true
that the examples given are exceptionally high-level.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There, done. ...Fufu, this is wonderful.
It is truly fitting as a trial on my path to becoming a saint.

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Desire-san, you've finished writing!
Would you mind sharing it with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
The goal I uphold as a saint is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —"To win a graded stakes race on surfaces other than turf."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd murmurs as if eager to say something.
I can understand what they're thinking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her aptitude is on turf. For her to win a graded race
on anything else is an exceedingly rare feat.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You all have expressions as though
you've just witnessed spirits. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, that's wonderful, Desire-san!
Let's give it our all to get closer to that goal!

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
First, how about running on the dirt track?
Transcend-san, would you run alongside her?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, calling on me?
In that case, I'll give it my all~

text_block_list.name: Pessimistic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Are they serious? No way,
matching up against Tran right from the start...?!

text_block_list.name: Fickle Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
A harsh reality check right off the bat?
That's so rouuugh...
choice_data_list: (I hope this doesn't break her spirit...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While everyone watched with restless, mixed feelings,
the tandem run soon began—!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —All right, feeling pretty good—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am the saint—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dash—!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Open the path to the other world!

text_block_list.name: Fickle Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: No way... what is that...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire surged forward.
Across a track she was unfamiliar with—
pressing right up to Transcend's nose.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... That was close, so close...! 
You seriously gave me a scare at the end there~!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No...
I still fell short.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However—as a saint, countless trials
such as this surely lie in wait along my journey.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And trials exist to be overcome.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: As long as we kindle the flame of hope in our hearts and keep believing in where the light resides... the light will surely answer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must simply advance wherever destiny leads.
In order to reach that radiant "land beyond."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her phrasing is as mysterious as ever. Yet,
there surely aren't many horse girls who can
believe in themselves to this degree.
choice_data_list: I feel like I caught a glimpse of what you believe in, too.
I feel like I caught a glimpse of what you believe in, too.
You truly looked just like a 'saint.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her phrasing is as mysterious as ever. Yet,
there surely aren't many horse girls who can
believe in themselves to this degree.
choice_data_list: I feel like I caught a glimpse of what you believe in, too.
I feel like I caught a glimpse of what you believe in, too.
You truly looked just like a 'saint.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That land" of which she speaks.
Though I don't fully understand it,
a warm feeling like a light of hope certainly reached me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... 
Fufu, it seems so indeed.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In the depths of your eyes as well,
I can see a glowing white flame.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Be sure never to let that flame burn out.
If you do, the light will surely find you as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho, nice.
Can I get in on some of that blessing too?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
May the divine blessing of light grace both of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The way she believed completely in herself and approached challenges to fulfill her goals was noble, just like a true saint.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I get ya.
She's, like, gorgeous and super cool, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Plus... look.
Everyone else has got that spark in their eyes now too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps inspired by Red Desire,
the look on everyone else's faces had changed,
and they were seriously contemplating their goals.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu, if that is the case, then I am glad.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Guiding everyone and elevating them to greater heights is also the duty of a saint. Come, let us go—
Together, toward the pinnacle of the heavens.
